map.📚 深度解析：平飞 T = D: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Level Flight T = D
map.平飞配平要求推力=阻力，由阻力公式算所需推力 T=D=½ρV²·C_D·S。: Level-flight trim requires thrust = drag; compute the required thrust T=D=½ρV²·C_D·S from the drag equation.
map.对比不同高度（密度下降）的所需推力，评估巡航推力设定。: Compare the thrust required at different altitudes (density falls) to assess the cruise thrust setting.
map.已知发动机可用推力，反推能达到的巡航速度。: Given the available engine thrust, back-calculate the achievable cruise speed.
map.巡航高度密度 ρ=0.4、速度 V=250 m/s、C_D=0.03、面积 S=: Cruise altitude density ρ=0.4, speed V=250 m/s, C_D=0.03 and area S=30 m². T=D=½×0.4×250²×0.03×30=½×0.4×62500×0.03×30=1125 N. The engine must continuously provide about 1.1 kN to maintain level flight.
map.所需推力和可用推力什么关系？: What is the relationship between thrust required and thrust available?
map.平飞/稳速时两者相等；加速或爬升需可用>所需（盈余用于加速/爬升）；所需>可用则: In level flight/steady speed they are equal; accelerating or climbing needs available > required (the surplus accelerates/climbs); required > available means decelerating and losing altitude. The performance envelope is the range over which available thrust covers required thrust.
map.高度对所需推力的影响？: How does altitude affect the thrust required?
map.密度随高度下降，同等真速下阻力减小，但真速巡航时维持动压需更高速，综合看巡航推力: Density falls with altitude, so drag at the same true speed decreases, but cruising at a higher true speed to maintain dynamic pressure may offset it; overall the cruise thrust first falls with altitude then is affected by engine decay. Checking the performance manual by altitude is most accurate.
map.平飞所需推力（本页代码口径）：T=½×ρ×v²×S×C_D（ρ 空气密度 kg/: Thrust required for level flight (page code convention): T=½×ρ×v²×S×C_D (ρ air density kg/m³, v speed m/s, S wing area m², C_D drag coefficient); linked values: dynamic pressure q=½ρv² (Pa), equivalent thrust=T÷9.80665 (kgf), kilonewton value=T÷1000 (kN, main result). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; T is proportional to the square of speed — doubling cruise speed raises required thrust to four times.
